mapper.sql: select mt.id, mt.user_id, mt.code, mt.name, mt.owner, mt.seller, mt.buyer, mt.liaison, mt.phone, mt.area, mt.address, mt.status, mt.enabled, mt.tenant, mt.deleted, mt.create_by, mt.creator_id, mt.creator_type, mt.create_time, mt.update_by, mt.updater_id, mt.updater_type, mt.update_time from `merchant` mt
mapper.select:
select m.id,m.code,m.name,m.user_id,m.owner,m.seller,m.buyer,m.liaison,m.phone,m.area,m.address, m.remark,m.status,m.enabled,a.type,m.create_time from merchant m left join authentication a on m.id = a.merchant_id
and a.type = #{param.type.name}
and ( m.name like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or m.liaison like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or m.phone like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") )
and m.seller = 1
and m.buyer = 1
and m.status = #{param.auditStatus.name}
group by id order by m.status asc
where mt.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mt.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

where.if: and mt.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mt.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
